# FLX-3112: an emit whose contract declares keys pins no contract digest

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Every key the engine generates is checked against the contract that declares it, so an emit of a contract that declares keys pins that contract's digest in provenance.contractDigest. A moved key then stops the plan with FLX-3101 instead of passing unnoticed. The message names the digest of the contract in the bundle: pin it once the keys are the ones you mean.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3112
```
